aiVerification.summary: Draft is not reliable because it mixes unrelated conditions and creates invalid before/after comparisons.
issues: Changed factor combines lot, repair status, sorting, and row labels into one incoherent factor.
Several pairs compare different material/lot conditions instead of matching before vs after repair within the same condition.
C2 move E2 sorting results are a separate outcome context and should not be treated as a changed condition.
Outcome domain and metric labels are generic or incorrect for weak-solder NG investigation.
Some cited evidence rows are headers or context only, not direct condition-result evidence.
correctionPlan: Define one review case for weak-solder NG investigation with subgrouped test conditions.
Pair rows 23/25, 27/29, 31/33, 35/37, and 53/55 only as same-condition before/after repair comparisons.
Keep rows 39, 41, 43, 45, 47, 49, and 51 as unpaired condition results unless matching after-repair rows exist.
Separate the C2 move E2 sorting sheet as supporting sorting evidence or a distinct outcome, not a changed factor.
Use direct row citations for each condition-result pair and cite title/content rows only as context.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations mostly exist, but they are not sufficient because grouping and pair logic are wrong.
